## Figure 3


### Figure 3a 

* Distribution of samples across age intervals

```{r}
summarise_stats = function(x, dataset)
{
    age = table(x$`Age Interval`) %>% reshape2::melt()
    age$Type = c(paste(dataset, "Sample", sep = "_"))
    individuals = x %>% group_by(`Age Interval`, DonorID) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(n = n()) %>%
        as.data.frame()
    individuals = table(individuals$`Age Interval`) %>% reshape2::melt()
    individuals$Type = c(paste("Individual", dataset, sep = "_"))

    age = rbind(age, individuals)
    colnames(age) = c("Age Interval", "n", "Type")
    age$dataset = c(as.character(dataset))
    return(age)

}

summarise_stats_single_sample <- function(x, dataset) {
    age = table(x$`Age Interval`) %>% reshape2::melt()   # <-- adjust column name if different
    colnames(age) = c("Age Interval", "n")

    # SampleID == DonorID here, so sample-level and individual-level counts
    # are identical -- just duplicate under both Type labels rather than
    # re-deriving via group_by(DonorID), which would be redundant.
    sample_rows = age
    sample_rows$Type = paste(dataset, "Sample", sep = "_")

    individual_rows = age
    individual_rows$Type = paste(dataset, "Individual", sep = "_")

    out = rbind(sample_rows, individual_rows)
    out$dataset = as.character(dataset)
    return(out)
}

summarise_regions = function(x, dataset){
    regions = x %>%
        dplyr::group_by(`Age Interval`, Regions) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(n = n())  %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        mutate(Dataset = dataset)
    return(regions)
}
```


```{r}
age_interval_stats = list()
directory = file.path(here::here("output"))
pattern = "/home/neuro/Documents/Brain_integrative_transcriptome/update/bithub/data-preprocessing/output/"
```

```{r}
for (f in directory){
    md = list.files(f, full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE, pattern = "\\-metadata.csv$")
    for (j in md){
        dataset = basename(j)
        dataset = gsub("\\-metadata.csv$", "", dataset)
        dataset = sub(".*/", "", dataset)   # catches any leftover path component

        ct_file = read.csv(j, header = TRUE, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
        message("Now calculating statistics for ", dataset)

        if (grepl("PsychENCODE", dataset, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
            stats = summarise_stats_single_sample(ct_file, dataset)
        } else {
            stats = summarise_stats(ct_file, dataset)
        }

        age_interval_stats[[paste(dataset)]] = stats
    }
}
```

```{r}
structure_col = "Regions"
structure_age_stats = list()

for (f in directory){
    md = list.files(f, full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE, pattern = "\\-metadata.csv$")
    for (j in md){
        dataset = basename(j)
        dataset = gsub("\\-metadata.csv$", "", dataset)
        dataset = sub(".*/", "", dataset)

        ct_file = read.csv(j, header = TRUE, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

        if (!structure_col %in% colnames(ct_file) || !"Period" %in% colnames(ct_file)) {
            message("Skipping ", dataset, " -- missing structure or period column")
            next
        }

        counts = ct_file %>%
            dplyr::count(.data[[structure_col]], Period, name = "n") %>%
            dplyr::rename(Region = 1, period = Period) %>%
            mutate(dataset = dataset)

        structure_age_stats[[dataset]] = counts
    }
}

all_structure_age = bind_rows(structure_age_stats)

# quick sanity check -- overall prenatal vs postnatal totals
period_totals = all_structure_age %>%
  group_by(period) %>%
  summarise(total_samples = sum(n), .groups = "drop")

```


## Figure 3b

```{r}
samples_per_dev = all_structure_age %>% 
  mutate(period = factor(period, levels = c("Prenatal", "Postnatal"))) %>%
ggplot( aes(x = period, y= n, fill = Region)) + 
    geom_bar(position = "dodge",stat= "identity", width = 0.5) + theme_bw() +


  facet_grid(dataset~`period`, scales = "free") +    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Cortex" = "#E85571", 
                                 "Subcortex" = "#838DE0", 
                                 "Cerebellum" = "#FFD256",
                                 "Spinal Cord" = "#C6D14A", 
                                 "Forebrain" = "#F6B19D", #
                                 "Midbrain" = "#AC93AD",
                                 "Hindbrain" = "#6E8B8E",
                                 "Brain" = "#FFA6B7", 
                                 "Chroid plexus" = "#9D696C"
                                ))  + ylab("Number of Samples") +xlab("") + 
  theme(legend.position = "top",
          legend.text = element_text(size = 5))

ggsave(plot= samples_per_dev, 
       filename = here::here("output/metadata/plots/Fig3b.png"),
       height = 6, 
       width = 5,
       dpi =1200,
       units = "in"
         )
```
